notes: The first navigation was fully drawn after about 3 seconds; the calibration reload was fully drawn after about 2 seconds. Magenta reached all four screenshot edges and no black bars were visible. The browser interaction surface was 1536x1024, but every saved CSS screenshot PNG was 1344x896, a uniform 0.875 visual reduction with offsetX=0 and offsetY=0. Pointer input still aligned with the supplied design coordinates when the outer surface was 1536x1024, so the required coordinates were passed unchanged for the real attempts. I temporarily enlarged the outer surface to 1728x1152 while investigating the PNG-size mismatch; that made the pointer scale differ and produced the three logged miss attempts, including one accidental title-bar drag. I restored 1536x1024 and reloaded before the successful BGM drag; page-2026-08-30T19-59-46-151Z.png is the clean loaded shot used for the real sequence. The dropdown row-hover screenshot did not show a distinct highlight-bar movement, and browser screenshots did not render the pointer, so the pointing-hand cursor could not be verified.
